caption:
Pay a collection and it's gone? Not quite. 🔍

Paid collections can still appear on a report until they age off, though newer scoring models treat paid ones better.

Check your own reports and situation.

Did you know this?
first_comment: Ever dealt with a collection? Share below 👇
sources: pattern: say this / nobody tells you

card.headline: A paid collection may still show on your report.
